## Learning goals

- compute and plot the ACF;
- contrast Beer with white noise.

```{r}
library(fpp3)
set.seed(1)
```

## 1. ACF for Beer

```{r}
aus_production |> autoplot(Beer)
aus_production |> ACF(Beer) |> autoplot()
```

## 2. White noise null

```{r}
wn <- tsibble(t = 1:200, y = rnorm(200), index = t)
wn |> ACF(y) |> autoplot()
```

## DELIVERABLE

Three bullet differences between Beer ACF and WN ACF.
